scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=zweckos-server && npm run lint --workspace=client
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=zweckos-server && npm run test --workspace=client
scripts.verify:release: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: cd server && npx prisma migrate deploy
